description: This file defines a report for stock ledger invariant checks in ERPNext, including functions to fetch stock ledger entries, compute invariant check fields, and generate report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries and adds invariant check fields.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Retrieves stock ledger entries from frappe database with specified filters.

methods.name: add_invariant_check_fields
methods.description: Calculates various invariant check metrics for each stock ledger entry.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the stock ledger invariant check report.
